sections.zh: 默认开启，可在搜索条件中关闭；开关选择会保存。仅转写字母参与混查：o/u、O/U、t/d、k/g。a 和 e 始终区分，不参与混查。大小写由“不分大小写”独立控制。
sections.en: Enabled by default; your choice in search filters is saved. Only transliteration uses these equivalences: o/u, O/U, t/d and k/g. The letters a and e remain distinct at every position. Ignore case is a separate option.

note_zh: 蒙古文字、罗马字转写与键盘按键的对应关系。点击图片可放大。
note_en: Correspondence between Mongolian letters, Roman transliteration and keyboard keys. Tap the chart to zoom.
fuzzy_zh: 这张表说明原网站的输入方式。本 App 的转写搜索不会自动转换为蒙古文；请按词条转写输入，或用蒙古文输入法输入原文。
fuzzy_en: This chart describes input on the source website. This app does not convert transliteration into Mongolian automatically. Search using the entry’s transliteration or type Mongolian with a Mongolian keyboard.
